sections.heading: Coverage Overview & Clinical Scope
sections.content: Computed Tomography (CT) of the head or brain is considered medically necessary when specific clinical indications are met. This guideline governs outpatient and elective advanced imaging pre-authorization.

sections.heading: Clinical Indication for Head CT
sections.content: Patient must have documented focal or generalized neurological symptoms or signs, including but not limited to severe persistent headaches with atypical features, dizziness, ataxia, or visual disturbances.

sections.heading: Duration of Clinical Symptoms
sections.content: For chronic or subacute headache presentations, clinical symptoms must persist for at least 6 weeks of active observation or documentation prior to advanced imaging request.

sections.heading: Previous Conservative Treatment
sections.content: A trial of conservative medical management (pharmacological, lifestyle modification, or physical therapy) must have been attempted without symptomatic resolution, unless red flag signs are present.

sections.heading: Documented Clinical Findings
sections.content: An in-person physical and neurological examination documented by a licensed clinician revealing abnormal or asymmetric findings is mandatory prior to authorization.

sections.heading: Rule Out Serious Intracranial Pathology
sections.content: The clinical indication must state the requirement to evaluate or rule out intracranial pathology, mass lesion, neoplasm, structural lesion, or acute hydrocephalus.

sections.heading: Intravenous Contrast Justification
sections.content: When intravenous contrast (CPT 70460) is requested, explicit diagnostic rationale justifying contrast enhancement (e.g., evaluation of suspected mass, neoplasm, infection, or vascular abnormality) must be provided.

criteria.name: Clinical Indication
criteria.requirement: Patient must have neurological symptoms or signs

criteria.name: Rule out Serious Condition
criteria.requirement: Must be to rule out intracranial pathology or mass

criteria.name: Contrast Justification
criteria.requirement: If contrast requested, must be clinically indicated
